args.theme: Current news/lifestyle topic: the most recent subscription price increase announced by ONE major video streaming service (pick the single most recent announcement; do not survey other services). Using only facts confirmed by web search (the company's own announcement, Reuters/AP/Bloomberg-level reporting), pin down: which service, the old and new price for each affected plan, the effective date(s), the market(s) covered, and the reason the company gave. Limit research to this one announcement; do not compare with other services or collect subscriber-reaction data. Do not invent details and do not use the assistant's own prior knowledge.
